title: Paper 2 E8: confirmation on PALM of label-free model selection by full deployment-gate rejection rate (TTA instability or radius rule)
nature: engineering study; confirmatory single run on a third external dataset. The full-gate criterion was found in exploratory analysis after the RIGA evaluation (E6b); the RIGA primary hypothesis G1 (TTA flag rate) remains not met and is not revised by this registration

data.dataset: PALM (Sci Data 2024; figshare 21299148, CC0, MD5 verified), never used before in this project
data.images: 1,200 (Zeiss 1,047, Canon 153); disc masks for 1,144; 89 images duplicated in REFUGE1 (thumbnail correlation >= 0.985) excluded from the primary analysis
data.same_eye_proxy: clusters of PALM images with thumbnail correlation >= 0.985 (1,066 clusters; largest 87 images, which makes cluster intervals conservative); no patient or eye identifiers are provided

reference: PALM consensus disc mask (disc = black), largest component centroid and sqrt(area/pi); one mask per image, so no inter-rater baseline; locked in results/fe/palm_ref/reference_lock.json without any FE model

procedure.stage_A: label-free: reads no reference and no mask; all 1,200 images; R0 and R1m crops; nine models single pass, ensembles, deployed pipelines; nine models through the deployed TTA code on R1m; selection recorded before stage B
procedure.stage_B: evaluation: requires the stage A file produced by this script; maps the reference and scores
procedure.fixed_settings: R1m crop fe/p2c_crop.py; failure = centre > 0.2 r_d or none; deployed TTA thresholds research 0.138, product 0.297 r_d; radius rule 15-46 px; no change after development

decision_rules.full_gate_rejection: share of images whose TTA frame on R1m is not valid (no centre, radius outside 15-46 px, or TTA-spread flag); images without a centre count as rejected
decision_rules.selection_denominator: all included images, with and without disc masks
decision_rules.optimal: all seeds with the lowest failure count as optimal
decision_rules.devices: Zeiss and Canon selected separately for per-device regret

hypotheses.P1_primary: Spearman across the nine fixed candidates between full-gate rejection rate and failure of the TTA frames on R1m (annotated included images), pooled; exact permutation p over 9!; met if rho > 0 and p < 0.05. Candidate-set-level criterion: the p value refers to these nine models, not to a population of models. The TTA flag rate criterion is reported alongside
hypotheses.P2_key_secondary: regret of the label-free choice per track, pooled; met if regret = 0 in both tracks; per-device regret reported
hypotheses.P3_key_secondary: research-track choice: silent failure among frames accepted by the full gate (annotated included images); primary 95% upper bound by cluster bootstrap (10,000 resamples, 97.5th percentile) or, with no observed failure, Clopper-Pearson with n = clusters among accepted images; met if < 5%; Wilson and image-level Clopper-Pearson bounds reported; product-track choice descriptive
hypotheses.P4_descriptive: failure and coverage of the chosen models by device, pathologic-myopia label, shooting centre and mask presence

secondary: TTA flag rate criterion; seed dependence under R1m (Cochran Q, Holm); deployed pipelines R1m vs R0 (exact McNemar, Holm); sensitivity including the 89 REFUGE1 duplicates. All auxiliary
interpretation_notes: conclusions refer to the annotated evaluation subset; images without masks are mostly pathologic myopia (49 of 56)
15 of 120 Canon reference radii exceed 46 px at 384, so the radius rule rejects some correct Canon frames; Canon has 120 annotated images
the nine candidates form three dependent groups
single_evaluation: stage A and stage B each run once; both refuse if their outputs exist or on any hash mismatch

selftest.result: PALM crop parity 0 on 15 images (no model); on 6 Chaksu Train images R0 and R1m TTA outputs identical to earlier locked/development results (0 failure mismatches); analysis ran end to end
